# ECN-2026-014 Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Reason for change
- Background: During routine maintenance and audit of Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02), inspection records and maintenance rounds identified recurring fastener seating anomalies at the main ram assembly. Previous corrective actions documented under ECN-2026-024 addressed related interface components but did not finalize the required target torque value for the main ram retaining bolt. Field technicians reported episodic joint relaxation and evidence of micro-movement at the ram flange interface. Root cause analysis identified an under-specified assembly torque as a contributing factor.
- Purpose: This engineering change establishes the required main ram bolt torque for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 to ensure joint integrity, reduce fretting at the ram flange, and improve dimensional stability of the ram position during production runs in Heat Treat operations. The change aligns assembly practice with mechanical fastener retention best practices and complements procedural updates in SOP-P1-L4-03 and maintenance task updates in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.

Affected items
- Equipment: Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2, EQ-P1-L4-HP02. The change applies to the main ram bolt at the ram to cylinder flange interface.
- Documents and procedures: SOP-P1-L4-03 is affected for assembly and startup checks; reference updates are required to include the specified torque. Maintenance work instructions MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 are affected to reflect the revised bolting requirement and to capture acceptance criteria for post-torque inspection. ECN-2026-024 remains a related change and should be consulted for component-level modifications that led to this torque determination.
- Records: Torque application records, bolted joint inspection checklists, and post-maintenance run-in logs must be updated to include the new torque entry for the main ram bolt.

Implementation
- Engineering determination: After mechanical analysis and review of the ram flange geometry and bolt class compatibility, the required main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 970 N·m. This value is provided to establish a repeatable target for assembly and verification.
- Procedure updates: Update SOP-P1-L4-03 to add a step requiring application of the main ram bolt torque value and to require torque verification stamping in the maintenance completion section. MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 shall be revised to include a dedicated torque step and to document torque tool calibration status at the time of work execution. Include a pass/fail acceptance criterion tied to complete seating and absence of visible gap or movement at the ram flange after torque application.
- Tools and calibration: Use calibrated torque wrench tooling appropriate for the specified torque. Prior to implementation, verify calibration records for torque application tools and capture calibration identifiers in the maintenance record entry for each torque event.
- Work control and sequencing: Implement the torque change during the next scheduled preventive maintenance window for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 or before the next hot cycle after the ECN is released, whichever occurs first. Coordinate with production planning to minimize impact on the Heat Treat schedule. Execute a dry-run bolting sequence on the ram assembly with the updated torque to verify ergonomics and access for technicians.
- Verification and validation: After torque application, perform a visual and tactile check for joint seating and confirm no excess gap. Perform functional checks required by SOP-P1-L4-03. Capture the torque reading from the calibrated tool in the maintenance record and sign off per MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2. Monitor the joint during the subsequent production cycles and record any evidence of loosening or movement. If loosening is observed, halt operation and initiate the escalation matrix documented in ECN-2026-024.
- Training: Provide a brief instruction and sign-off for maintenance staff performing the torque application. Training shall cover the new torque value, the updated steps in SOP-P1-L4-03 and MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, tooling selection, and recordkeeping expectations. Training attendance and competency confirmation shall be retained with the maintenance records for EQ-P1-L4-HP02.
- Examples: Example entries in the maintenance log should include the equipment id, the applied torque value, tool calibration id, technician initials, and a remark field noting joint condition post-torque. Use the format specified in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 for consistency across records.

Records to keep
- A copy of the revised SOP-P1-L4-03 and MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, with revision reference and change summary.  
- Torque application records for each execution on EQ-P1-L4-HP02, including the applied value and torque tool calibration reference.  
- Post-torque inspection checklist completed and signed per MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.  
- Training attendance and competency records for personnel authorized to apply the main ram bolt torque.  
- Any follow-up observations or corrective action entries referencing ECN-2026-024 where applicable.

Approvals
- Engineering: Approval required to confirm the mechanical basis for the specified torque and to authorize changes to SOP-P1-L4-03 and MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2.  
- Maintenance management: Approval required to schedule implementation and to confirm tool availability and calibration compliance.  
- Operations supervision: Approval required to accept the implementation plan and to coordinate production impact mitigation.  
- Records of approval signatures and dates shall be filed with the ECN and retained in the document control system alongside the updated procedural documents.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-024  
- MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2  
- SOP-P1-L4-03

Note: The single explicit assembly torque requirement for this change is recorded as the main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 970 N·m. All execution and verification steps shall reference that value exactly as documented above.
